object_registration.description: Scaled analogue of the paper's Sec. 5.1 object registration: 13 paired planes fitted (RANSAC + least-squares refit) from 100 noisy point measurements each, 5/20/35/50 percent outlier points, random rigid transforms; scored on held-out instances.
object_registration.notes: Results are this gym's hidden-test measurements (200 held-out instances, scoring/scores_test.json) for the registered solvers. The paper's Space Station model is not distributed and its Fig. 3 results are curves on a different object and scale, so they are kept only as approximate readings under _paper_reported_fig3_approx and are not targets for this gym.

translation_error_percent.description: Mean over instances of ||t_hat - t_gt|| / ||t_gt|| * 100, each instance capped at 100 (no better than a zero-translation guess). A run with any invalid pose scores 100.

rotation_error_deg.description: Mean over instances of acos((trace(R_hat^T R_gt) - 1) / 2) in degrees (at most 180). A run with any invalid pose scores 180.

_paper_reported_fig3_approx.source: Fig. 3 of the paper (Space Station model, 500 sets per outlier ratio), values read approximately from the plotted curves at 5% and 50% outliers and averaged over the plotted ratios 5-50%.

object_registration_mismatched.description: Same object-registration task with 2, 3 or 4 of the 13 plane correspondences mismatched (targets cyclically permuted among the chosen planes), on top of 5/20/35/50 percent outlier points; scored on held-out instances.
object_registration_mismatched.notes: Results are this gym's hidden-test measurements (120 held-out instances, scoring/scores_test.json). Added where the paper's refinement falls short: the paper states that refining a linear solution depends on the initial solver filtering outlier correspondences, and reports Refine failing on the mismatch-heavy Replica Room1 sequence while its inlier-set-maximising BnB succeeds. The paper has no object-registration numbers for this setting.
